en-US.longDescription: Visual Subst provides a clean interface for managing virtual and network drives. It addresses four limitations of the built-in SUBST and NET USE commands by adding editable drive labels and icons, creating UAC drives for elevated applications, managing the Recycle Bin for deleted items, and restoring virtual drives after reboots.
en-US.name: Visual Subst
